mods.name: Xray
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: See ores and gems through the ground.
mods.description:
Press your Xray key and stone, dirt and sand fade away, leaving only the stuff worth digging for. Ores, gems, crystals and rare blocks stay visible, so you can see where a vein is before you dig.

You choose what shows. There's a switch for every ore and gem (iron, coal, gold, cobalt, sulphur, amethyst, pyrite, devil ores and the rest), and for liquids like water, lava, acid and swamp. There are separate groups for space rocks and value blocks too. All On and All Off flip a whole group at once.

Don't like everything around you going invisible? Turn up the Ground see-through slider and the ground stays faintly visible, so you can still tell where the edges are and don't walk off a cliff.
mods.changelog:
What's new
- Ground see-through slider (Xray settings): 0 = ground invisible like before, turn it up to see the ground faintly so you don't walk off a cliff
- Added the new 14.5 ores: Pyrite Ore and Amethyst
Needs framework 1.2.0

mods.name: Block Story Core
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: The framework every Mod Kit mod runs on — install it once, it updates itself.
mods.description:
Block Story Core is the engine room behind every mod in the Mod Kit. It loads your mods when the game starts and gives them a shared toolbox, so creators don't rebuild the basics every time: adding blocks and items, making custom creatures and pets with their own models, hooking into the world, the player and game events, and binding keys. It also adds the "Mods" button to the game's main menu so you can see and manage what's running.

If a mod says it "needs Core," this is it. You install it once — after that it updates on its own through the Mod Kit whenever there's a new version. On its own it changes nothing about how the game plays; it just makes the other mods work.

Open source. No ads, nothing tracked, nothing hidden.

─────────────────────────────
For creators: adding your mod to the Mods menu

If you build with the Mod Kit, this is already done for you — your mod shows up in the in-game Mods button, with its own on/off switch, automatically.

If you're coding a mod without the Kit, it takes one step. Reference BlockStoryCore.dll (it sits in your game's BepInEx/plugins folder once Core is installed), and in your plugin's Awake() register with the toolbox:

    using BlockStoryCore;

    ModRegistry.Register(new ModInfo
    {
        Name        = "My Mod",
        Description = "What my mod does.",
        GetEnabled  = () => _enabled,        // your mod's current on/off state
        SetEnabled  = on => _enabled = on,   // flip your mod on/off
        HasConfig   = true,                  // false if your mod has no settings
        OpenConfig  = () => { /* open your settings screen */ }
    });

That's the whole hook. Core draws the row, the ON/OFF switch, and (if HasConfig) a Config button, and the menu scrolls to fit any number of mods. The rest of the toolbox — blocks, items, creatures, pets, world/player/event hooks, keybinds — lives in the same BlockStoryCore namespace; see the toolbox docs for those.
mods.changelog:
Update for Block Story 14.5 - everyone needs this one.
- Fixes the game's main menu buttons not working with mods installed on 14.5
- New helpers for mods (online / Realm checks, per-world save names)
- Older mods keep working as before
Update it with the Launcher's Update button or Settings > Setup.

mods.name: Character Editor
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Change your stats, items, world and quests.
mods.description:
A full editor for your character and your world, for single-player.

- Stats: set your level, XP, skill points and diamonds. Fill or raise your health, mana, breath and hunger, set your armour and damage, or turn on god mode.
- Talents: set any talent, max them all or reset them.
- World: switch between Survival, Creative, Story, Hardcore and Sandbox without losing your stuff. You can also turn on flying in any mode, set the time of day and pick the weather.
- Inventory: add any item to your bag, crafting slots or hotbar. Fill your equipment slots and repair your gear.
- Pets: edit your summoned pet's level, XP, health and hunger.
- Quests: start, finish or reset any quest, with or without the reward.
- Achievements: complete them one at a time or all at once.
- Saves: save your whole loadout and load it back later.

Good for testing a build, fixing a save that went wrong, or just playing your way.
mods.changelog:
Block Story 14.5 update
- Resetting a quest no longer breaks on 14.5
- Quests on the new Old storyline now start, complete and reset properly
- Lowering your diamond count works again
- Added the new Sandbox mode to the game mode buttons
Needs framework 1.2.0

mods.name: Minimap
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: A minimap, a full world map and waypoints.
mods.description:
A round minimap in the corner of your screen shows the land around you, with mobs, animals and NPCs marked with their names. It can stay pointing north or turn with you. You can zoom it, make it bigger or show your coordinates above it.

Open the full world map for the big picture. It remembers everywhere you've been, so the map fills in as you explore. Drag it around, zoom in and out, or switch between the surface and cave view.

Waypoints let you mark your base, a good mine or anywhere else you want to find again. Pick a name, colour and icon, and it shows on both maps with how far away it is. Right-click the world map to drop one right there. When you die, a waypoint goes where it happened, so you can go get your stuff back.

Every world keeps its own map and waypoints. Realms and online servers get their own too, so they never draw over each other.
mods.changelog:
- Waypoint names on the map and minimap are readable now (they were squashed onto two lines)
- Names near the edge of the map stay inside it instead of getting cut off
- Edit and Del in the waypoint list no longer get cut off
Needs framework 1.2.0

mods.name: NPC Menu
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Talk to any NPC from anywhere.
mods.description:
Press the NPC key for a list of every NPC in the game. Click Talk and their normal quest window opens, as if you'd walked up to them. Take new quests or hand in finished ones without the long walk back.

The number next to each name shows how many quests that NPC has for you, so you can see who's worth visiting.

NPCs are switched off in Creative mode, so the menu only works in the other modes.

mods.name: Xenor
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: A new creature you can fight, catch and ride.
mods.description:
Xenor is a big new alien creature that lives in the space biomes. It levels up as you go further out, hits hard, spits acid, and drops meat, acid, bone, graviton and sometimes dark matter.

You can get your own Xenor in two ways:
- Catch it: catch a wild one with a soul catcher to get its spawner. Then craft the Xenor Soul from the spawner, Spider Fangs, a Dragon Heart, Dragonscale and Bones.
- Buy it: buy the Xenor Soul with diamonds.

Hold the soul and your Xenor appears as a pet. It follows you, fights for you, levels up and has its own inventory. You can name it, and you can climb on and ride it.

mods.name: Vein Miner
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Break a whole ore vein in one hit.
mods.description:
Hit one block of ore and every connected block of the same kind breaks with it. Everything goes straight into your inventory, and you still get your XP and your normal drop chances for each block.

It isn't only for ore. Switch the dig shape to dig a pillar up or down, or cut a staircase up or down. Choose how many blocks a single hit can take and how deep the shapes go.

Your tool wears per block like normal mining, or you can turn that off. Protect my tool stops it just before your pick breaks, so you never lose a good one halfway through a vein.

Press the Vein Miner key to turn it on or off whenever you like.
mods.changelog:
- New Gap reach slider (0 to 10): also mines the same ore a few blocks away when a vein has gaps
- New key to switch dig shape ([ by default)
- Gap searches run in the background, no stutter even at 10
- Cobwebs, plants and other walk-through blocks can be vein mined now
- Max blocks, depth, dig shape and on/off are saved between sessions

mods.name: Craft From Inventory
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: A recipe panel by the crafting grid that pulls from your bag and nearby chests.
mods.description:
Crafting without the back-and-forth. Craft From Inventory puts a recipe panel right next to your crafting grid, in your inventory and at the crafting table. Find what you want by category or search, click it, and the ingredients drop straight into the grid. It pulls from your bag and from any chests nearby, so you don't have to go fetch stuff first.

Want a lot? Ctrl-click loads 10 crafts, Shift-click loads 100, and Alt-click adds one more each time with a running count. The same keys work on the crafted item to make that many in one go. Changed your mind? Clear sends everything back to the chest it came from.

Quick stack is in too. Press one key and everything in your bag goes onto matching stacks in nearby chests, without opening them. Your hotbar and tools stay put.

Only shows recipes you've unlocked, so it won't spoil your progress. You can peek at locked ones if you want. Chest range is a slider from 4 to 64 blocks. Single player only.
mods.changelog:
- Furnace recipes load real fuel (coal first, then wood) instead of saying not enough energy
- Items like spider webs in chests count now, ingredients match the way the game does
- Any wood plank works where a recipe wants planks

mods.name: Soul Tools
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Spawners spawn on every click and the soul catcher locks on from any distance.
mods.description:
Two fixes for things that feel random in the base game.

Sure-fire spawners: left click a spawner and it spawns one creature, every single click. Mob caps, a crowd around it or a shaky mouse no longer eat your clicks. The spawner's own timer keeps running like normal, this only adds the ones you ask for.

Lock-on soul catcher: aim at a creature and click once. The catch locks on and keeps charging by itself, at any range, even if you let go or walk off. Click again or put the staff away to stop. Mana works like normal.

Both parts have their own switch in the settings. Single player only.

mods.name: Better Fishing
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Auto catch, every catch lands, no rod cooldown and a tougher rod.
mods.description:
Fishing without the waiting and the misses.

Auto catch reels in the moment a fish bites, before it can break the line. Every catch lands, the base game only lands about half. No rod cooldown, so you can throw again straight away. Rod wear is a slider: 100% is normal, 25% makes the rod last about 4 times longer, 0% means it never wears out.

Bait still gets used like normal. Every option has its own switch.
